author: Main only; output-exposed engineering adjudication, not independent labels or a representative practitioner sample
selection: First differing-risk coincidence examples inspected in BoringSSL, BC and MimeKit, a package declaration, and two immutable source API/compound questions. Not a random sample or global FP/risk-accuracy denominator.
scope: Six source/specification judgments. Initial47 and separate supplemental6 matching metrics are unchanged; remaining overlaps remain unadjudicated. One inert-fixture actionable-use counterexample is not relabeled as a nominated API false positive.

cases.riskJudgment: The algorithm-family RSA susceptibility labels are consistent with the requested primitive; the generic source rule quantum-uncertain label expresses contextual uncertainty. No actual deployment or migration verdict follows.
cases.issue: Semantic overlap, not a wrong primitive identity.

cases.sourceFact: XML documentation for the registry constant TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_NULL_SHA; the following line declares constant0xC010. Neither line selects/enables/negotiates a suite.
cases.duplicateJudgment: Two rules describe one suite-name reference, with broader RSA-based and ECDHE/RSA facets; no independent occurrence count is justified.
cases.riskJudgment: RFC4492 assigns ephemeral ECDH key exchange and RSA authentication to ECDHE_RSA. TLS_RSA_CIPHER_SUITE correctly says RSA-based and its hint explicitly distinguishes authentication from static RSA transport. However Critical/usage wording at a documentation reference cannot establish project exposure; active selection and policy are absent.
cases.issue: Context/severity overstatement for an actionable-use interpretation; no evidence of an incorrect ECDHE/RSA role assignment.
